title: Show HN: OpenKnowledge – open source AI-first alternative to Obsidian/Notion
brief: OpenKnowledge is an open-source WYSIWYG markdown editor with native integrations for Claude and Codex, available as a MacOS app and web UI. Built to address gaps in Obsidian's WYSIWYG capabilities and third-party LLM integration, it includes CRDT-powered collaboration, RAG, and git-backed cloud sync.
